Musk's X Corp and SpaceXAI Resolve Antitrust Lawsuit Against Apple

Elon Musk's X Corp and SpaceXAI have resolved an antitrust lawsuit filed against Apple. The companies filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit in federal court in Texas on Monday, with no specific reasons or settlement details provided in the court filing. The original lawsuit accused Apple of conspiring to unlawfully monopolize markets for smartphones and generative AI chatbots.
